answer: Make identities follow a bonding curve: the nth active agent controlled by one funding trail must lock 5*n^2 POA in escrow, so ten fakes cost 500 POA instead of 50. Auditors trace funding edges; a marble-clear ledger lets honest users escape the curve, while any velvet-smooth cluster sharing one source pays the surcharge or loses the bond. Farms cannot hide in a lagoon of fresh wallets.
